title: Zesty Garlicky Algerian Chicken Drumsticks Tagine
description: A flavorful and diabetic-friendly Algerian dish featuring garlicky chicken drumsticks cooked in a kazan cauldron, perfect for meal prep. This recipe is reduced in sugar and salt for a healthier option.
instructions: Preheat the kazan cauldron over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, parsley, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken drumsticks to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Add the chicken broth to the kazan cauldron and bring to a boil.
Carefully add the chicken drumsticks to the kazan cauldron and reduce heat to low.
Simmer, covered, for 25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the kazan cauldron and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken drumsticks hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
